color: Sets the foreground color of an element's text and text decorations.
display: Sets whether an element is treated as a block or inline box and the layout used for its children.
grid-template-columns: Defines the line names and track sizing functions of the grid columns.
grid-template-rows: Defines the line names and track sizing functions of the grid rows.
background: Sets the background styles of an element, including color, image, position, and size.
background-color: Sets the background color of an element.
width: Sets the width of an element.
height: Sets the height of an element.
margin: Sets the margin area on all four sides of an element.
padding: Sets the padding area on all four sides of an element.
border: Sets an element's border, including its width, style, and color.
position: Sets how an element is positioned in a document.
top: Sets the vertical position of a positioned element.
right: Sets the horizontal position of a positioned element from the right edge.
bottom: Sets the vertical position of a positioned element from the bottom edge.
left: Sets the horizontal position of a positioned element from the left edge.
font: Sets an element's font properties, including style, weight, size, and family.
font-size: Sets the size of the font.
font-family: Sets the font family for text.
font-weight: Sets the weight (or boldness) of the font.
line-height: Sets the height of a line box.
text-align: Sets the horizontal alignment of inline content within a block.
text-decoration: Sets the appearance of decorative lines on text.
overflow: Sets how content that exceeds an element's padding box is handled.
flex: Sets how a flex item grows and shrinks to fit available space.
flex-direction: Sets the direction in which flex items are placed in a flex container.
justify-content: Sets how browser distributes space between and around content items along the main axis.
align-items: Sets the align-self value on all direct children as a group.
gap: Sets the gaps between rows and columns.
opacity: Sets the transparency of an element.
transform: Applies a transformation to an element.
transition: Sets the transition between two states of an element.
cursor: Sets the mouse cursor to display when it is over an element.
